card.text: Explore Polydeuces, a small moon of Saturn, through its measured shape.

introduction.text: Polydeuces shares Dione’s orbit around Saturn, wandering around its trailing Lagrange region. Cassini measured this small moon’s elongated outline.

normal.title: ISS CL1/IR1 image
normal.summary: Only about 9 × 7 source pixels resolve the moon. Brightness is approximate; the gray grid marks unobserved surface.
